source_units.text: Write the final scene of an original audio drama.
Its intended audience: listeners at the end of an original drama episode.
These invented details are required: The final scene has three knocks on a sealed door.
The protagonist hears her own voice from behind it saying Do not open it, although she is standing outside.
Include each of these exact strings: "three knocks", "her own voice", "Do not open it".
